definition.load: on demand through the canonical runtime-overlay loader
definition.state: stateless; request and result live only in the synchronous resident call context
definition.window: exclusive owner of the single $C356 runtime-overlay window for the duration of one call
definition.generation: bound to the currently selected, nonzero Session-family generation
definition.publication: the service record is emitted and authenticated by the one Session-family L65R emitter

first_instance.name: intern-session-service
first_instance.operation: validated Lisp string to canonical interned symbol
resident_work: string-domain check through the same one-copy predicate as public stringp
service_work: copy the validated immutable string to the canonical name scratch

closure.overlay_to_service: no runtime-overlay body may request the service
closure.service_while_overlay: a service request while the window is busy returns VM_RUNTIME_OVERLAY_ERR_BUSY before wipe, read, DMA or entry
closure.busy_window_identity: the occupied window is byte-identical before and after the rejected request
closure.session_only: the service is absent from the Boot catalog and callable only with the selected Session family and generation
closure.vm_code_buffer_lifetime: the shared resident service facade invalidates the vm_codebuf bank/object owner before writing its synchronous context there; every successful CALLPRIM return therefore reloads and reparses the caller before consuming another literal or opcode

required_gates: one named Session catalog record and one entry symbol
no overlay-to-service call edge in the linked ELF
busy rejection dominates every window mutation and payload read
busy-call fixture preserves the complete window byte-for-byte
inactive, Boot-family, zero-generation and stale-generation calls reject
service record bounds, CRC, entry and family identity use the canonical L65R path
vm_codebuf context overwrite is dominated by bank/object owner invalidation and the linked CALLPRIM successor retains BUF_ENSURE_MINE
one Session pack quantum and no Boot record

capacity.resident_rule: the existing shared transport stub, one slot selection and the required pre-load argument validation may debit resident code; conversion remains cold
capacity.first_red: any terminal wall, Session aggregate overflow, or second execution window

claim_limit: Contract and product-shaped WPLTO only. No successor link, hardware, require or defstruct runtime claim.
